title: Autumn second-hand list
intro: Fictional example. Lucas is a made-up person and every listing, price and link here is invented. Your own list comes from your photos, your looks and real listings checked while you are signed in.
body: M fits loose, L fits oversized
W31 to W32, or M with elastic

looks.alt: Look 01 on Lucas: long white band-collar shirt worn untucked over wide black drawstring trousers
Look 02 on Lucas: black collarless chore jacket over a grey t-shirt, wide black trousers
Look 03 on Lucas: faded blue work jacket over a white band-collar shirt, wide black trousers

sections.title: Wide black trousers
sections.text: The base of three of Lucas's four favourite looks. One good pair covers all of them.

items.title: Japanese-cut drawstring trousers
items.note: The seller lists flat measurements in the photos: waist 40 cm, length 104 cm.

items.title: Pantalon large à pinces
items.note: 2 cm wider at the waist than Lucas's reference pair. A French listing, so the question for the seller is in French.
items.ask: Bonjour ! Pourriez-vous me donner la longueur de l'entrejambe et la largeur du bas de jambe, mesurées à plat ? Merci beaucoup !

items.title: Wool-blend wide trousers
items.note: The title says cotton, the listing details say wool. Kept here to show how a mismatch is flagged.

sections.title: White band-collar shirt
sections.text: Worn untucked over the wide trousers.

sections.title: Steel signet ring
sections.text: Stainless steel does not tarnish. Ring size is the inner diameter in millimetres.
steps: Wrap a thread around the finger where the ring will sit.
Mark where it closes and measure the length in millimetres.
Divide by 3.14. That is the diameter the listings show.

items.title: Brand-name steel signet
items.note: The best discount on this list, compared with the brand's own shop.

items.title: Silver signet with onyx
items.note: Silver only when it is worth it: a branded piece at less than half its shop price.

closing.title: Before paying
paragraphs: The shipping shown is the cheapest option of each listing. At checkout the total changes with the delivery you pick.
Ask the seller for flat measurements when you are not sure about the size.
